Name: Bathhouse Shortcut
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] [/b]Not a file update, but I wanted to mention that this should be fully compatible with the official 1.1 game update!

[youtube]lL-bTOgHzvc[/youtube]

A quick mod I made for faster visits to the bathhouse. Note that you're able to use your scythe and other tools while in the pool which looks funny.. I didn't set up the paths section to enable you to get in and out as fast as possible. If you go in through the normal way, you will change as normal then you can walk around town in your unmentionables.
